questions.question: If the ball, delivered by the bowler, not being a Wide, passes the striker without touching his/her bat or person, any runs completed by the batters from that delivery, or a boundary allowance, shall be credited as _________.
questions.questionHtml: If the ball, delivered by the bowler, not being a Wide, passes the striker without touching his/her bat or person, any runs completed by the batters from that delivery, or a boundary allowance, shall be credited as _________.
questions.solution: In cricket, byes are runs scored when the ball, delivered by the bowler within acceptable range (not a wide), passes the batter without touching their bat or body. If the batters complete runs or the ball reaches the boundary without being gathered by fielders, these runs are credited as byes. This distinguishes byes from leg byes, where the ball touches the batter's body. Byes can be scored either by running between the wickets or by the ball crossing the boundary, adding to the batting team's total score.

questions.question: In which year did India win its first Olympic gold in hockey?

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 1928.

  • This victory marked the beginning of India's dominance in field hockey, leading to multiple gold medals in subsequent Olympics.

Additional Information

    • He played a pivotal role in securing gold medals for India in the 1928, 1932, and 1936 Olympics.
  • Indian Hockey Team's Olympic Success
    • India's men's hockey team has won a total of eight Olympic gold medals (1928, 1932, 1936, 1948, 1952, 1956, 1964, 1980).
    • The team set an Olympic record by winning six consecutive gold medals from 1928 to 1956.
  • Field Hockey in the Olympics
    • Field hockey has been a part of the Summer Olympics since 1908 for men and 1980 for women.
    • It is one of the oldest team sports in the Olympic Games.
  • Evolution of the Game
    • Field hockey has evolved significantly over the years with changes in rules, equipment, and playing surfaces.
    • Modern field hockey is played on artificial turf, which allows for faster and more dynamic gameplay.

questions.question: In Badminton, the length and width of the doubles court shall be of ______________.
questions.questionHtml: In Badminton, the length and width of the doubles court shall be of ______________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 13.40 m × 6.10 m.

Key Points

  • 13.40 m × 6.10m is the official dimension for badminton doubles court.
  • The length of the court is 13.40 meters, and the width is 6.10 meters.
  • These dimensions are set by the Badminton World Federation (BWF) and are followed in all official tournaments.
  • The court has a center line that divides it into two equal halves, and there are service boxes marked on both sides.
  • The net is placed in the center, and its height is 1.55 meters at the edges and 1.524 meters in the center.

Additional Information

Badminton Overview:

  • Sport Type: Racquet sport played using racquets to hit a shuttlecock across a net.
  • Team Members: Can be played as singles (one player per side) or doubles (two players per side).
  • Equipment: Shuttlecock and racquet.
  • Playing Area: Played on a rectangular indoor court.
  • Objective: Points are scored by hitting the shuttlecock with the racquet and making it land within the opponent's half of the court.
  • Shuttlecock: A feathered or plastic projectile that decelerates rapidly due to its design.
  • Origin: Developed in British India from the earlier game of battledore and shuttlecock. Became popular in Asia, especially in China.
  • Olympic Debut: Introduced in the Summer Olympics in 1992 with events like men's singles, women's singles, men's doubles, and women's doubles. Mixed doubles was added later.
  • Physical Demands: Requires aerobic stamina, agility, strength, speed, and precision. It's also a technical sport demanding good motor coordination.

Court Dimensions:

  • Full Width: 6.1 metres (20 feet) for doubles and 5.18 metres (17.0 feet) for singles.
  • Full Length: 13.4 metres (44 feet).
  • Net Height: 1.55 metres (5 feet 1 inch) at the edges and 1.524 metres (5.00 feet) in the center.

questions.question: The X-ring on the archery target is the ______ inner ring.
questions.questionHtml: The X-ring on the archery target is the ______ inner ring.
questions.solution: The X-ring on an archery target is the inner ring of the 10th scoring zone and represents the highest scoring area, positioned at the center of the target. It determines if an arrow lands in the perfect 10-point zone. The X-ring is used to distinguish between arrows in the 10-point zone that may not be in the exact same position. The innermost ring scores 10 points, with surrounding rings scoring progressively lower, down to 1 point for the outermost ring.

questions.question: What is the weight of the shot put for the men's category?
questions.questionHtml: What is the weight of the shot put for the men's category?
questions.solution: The men's shot put weighs 16 pounds and is a track and field event where athletes "put" (push) a heavy spherical object as far as possible. To ensure fairness, official competitions standardize the weight. In contrast, the women's shot put weighs 8.8 pounds (4 kg). Shot put has ancient origins and has been part of the modern Olympics since 1896. Athletes use techniques like the glide and spin to maximize their distance. The International Association of Athletics Federations (IAAF) recognizes world records in shot put, and proper technique and strength training are crucial for success.

questions.question: Sagol Kangjei, an indigenous game of Manipur is similar to the modern day sports of:
questions.questionHtml: Sagol Kangjei, an indigenous game of Manipur is similar to the modern day sports of:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is polo.

Important Points

  • The Sagol Kangjei has been adapted and adopted by the international enthusiasts of the game as Polo and now it's being played worldwide.
  • Today, the world has accepted that the game of Polo originated from Manipur.
  • The Manipuri Polo is played with seven players (on each side) who mount and ride ponies, which are usually 4/5 feet in height. Each player is fitted with a Polo-stick made of bamboo root.

Additional Information

  • Yubi Lakpi is Manipuri Rugby.
    •  “Yubi” in Manipur means coconut and “Lakpi” means snatching.
  • In Manipur, Hiyang Tannaba is Boat Race.
    • It is generally held in November at Thangapat (Moat). The boats called Hiyang Hiren are regarded to be invested with spiritual powers and the game is associated with religious rites.
  • Mukna is Manipuri Wrestling.
    • The game is the Manipuri style of wrestling played between two male rivals for a trial of strength by sheer physical strength and skill.

Key Points

  • Cricket originated in South England.
  • The modern game of hockey emerged in England in the mid-18th century.
  • Boxing originated in Egypt.
    • This sport was introduced to the ancient Olympic Games by the Greeks in the late 7th century BC.

questions.question: When was the Indian Hockey Federation established?

questions.solution: The Indian Hockey Federation (IHF) was the apex governing body of field hockey in India, established on 7 November 1925 in Gwalior. questions.question: Who among the following won the gold medal in the girls' under 15 category at the Asian Juniors Individual Squash Championship in June 2022?
questions.questionHtml: Who among the following won the gold medal in the girls' under 15 category at the Asian Juniors Individual Squash Championship in June 2022?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Anahat Singh.

Key Points

  • Anahat Singh:
    • She is an Indian squash player who was born on March 13, 2008.
    • She was the youngest athlete to represent India at the 2022 Commonwealth Games, having turned 14 years old.
    • She took home the Asian Junior Squash Individual Championships Girls U15 championship in June 2022.
    • She emerged victorious at the August 2023 Asian Junior Squash Individual Championships in Dalian, China, winning the Girls U17 division.
    • Subsequently, she won two bronze medals in the women's team event and mixed doubles alongside Abhay Singh in Asian Games, 2022.

Additional Information

  • Squash:
    • It is a racquet and ball sports, but squash's dynamics are very different from other racquet and ball sports like tennis etc.
    • It was created in England in the early 1800s and has quickly become well-liked by players of all skill levels.
    • It is a part of the Asian Games since 1986 and the Commonwealth Games since 1998, although not yet being an Olympic sport.
    • Since the mid-1970s, there have also been high-profile, specialised competitions such as the World Squash Championships.
  • Asians Games:
    • The Asian Games, also known as Asiad, is a multi-sport event held every four years among athletes from across Asia.
    • They were regulated by the Asian Games Federation (AGF) till 1978.
    • The first games were in New Delhi, India, in 1951.
    • Since the breakup of the Asian Games Federation in 1982, the Olympic Council of Asia (OCA) has organized the Games.
    • The Games are recognized by the International Olympic Committee (IOC) and are described as the second largest multi-sport event after the Olympic Games.
    • The next edition is expected to be held in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan in 2026.

questions.question: What is the length of a hockey field?
questions.questionHtml: What is the length of a hockey field?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 91.4 m.

Key Points

  • The place on which field hockey is challenged is 91.4m long and 55m wide. 
  • This border is marked on the turf and the shorter lines are known as backlines.
  • Field Hockey is an eleven-aside game played on a pitch 100 yards by 60 yards with a ball that has a 23cm circumference.  
  • Every player has a stick with a rounded top to play the ball with and the target is to score goals by putting the ball in the rival team's goal. 
  • Field Hockey Pitch has a general length of 100 yards (91.44 m) and a width of 60 yards (54.86 m), for a whole area of 54,000 ft² (5017 m²). 

Additional Information

  • Field hockey is a team sport organized in standard hockey format, in which every team plays with ten outfield players and a goalkeeper. 
  • Teams must need a round hockey ball hitting it with a hockey stick toward the opposing team's shooting circle and then into the goal. 
  • The match is won by the team that achieves the majority of goals. 

  • The game is played in the middle of two teams of eleven, 10 field players and one goalkeeper, who are allowed to be on the pitch at any one time. ​
